response.sql: WITH per_item_stats AS (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN product_price IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 THEN product_price / derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_per_item_avg_ratios, AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_of_per_item_counts FROM per_item_stats;

assumptions.assumption: Rows where derived_total_cost is 0 should be excluded from each item's ratio average to avoid division by zero

alternatives.interpretation: Do not explicitly exclude rows with derived_total_cost = 0; let the database handle division by zero
alternatives.sql: WITH per_item_stats AS (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN product_price IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN product_price / derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_per_item_avg_ratios, AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_of_per_item_counts FROM per_item_stats;
